title: poa nemoralis subsp. uniflora
intro: Poa nemoralis subsp. uniflora, commonly known as Wood Meadow-grass, is a subspecies of the Poa nemoralis plant, belonging to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial grass native to Europe and Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Poa nemoralis subsp. uniflora include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
